raw_text: Great app and incredibly easy to use! However, Groww, aren't you missing out on a massive customer base of retailers and shopkeepers in Tier 2 and 3 cities? Introducing a dedicated and highly visible 'Daily SIP' or daily micro-investment feature for them would be a total game-changer. Keep up the good work, but definitely think about tapping into this market!
